digest.component_or_area: Continuous Integration / GitHub Actions / Test Performance
propositions: Ubuntu default test cells consume 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run; bridge cadence test alone consumes 100-130s due to repeated YAML parsing inside 1,440-minute comprehension loop.

Pandoc corpus and hardening tests invoke real Pandoc 3,421 times (232 in corpus + 884 in hardening + 1,305 legacy redundancy) at 30-70ms per invocation; corpus existential assertion requires only 1 subprocess witness, and legacy hardening oracle duplicates work already proven by real _convert.
AST provenance fixture setup consumes 46-55s across three Ubuntu Python cells via repeated enclosing-caller and parent-relationship discovery; caller/parent indices can be built once per process.
Complexity policy static check runs identically in every Ubuntu/macOS matrix cell (45-55s), duplicating OS-invariant work four times when it could run once in lint job.
Live Jira DC test suite (63 tests) is already excluded from Gerrit Verified by 'not external' selector and runs only in weekly/manual external harness; moving it saves zero Verified occupancy.

Full real-Pandoc substitution with static golden fixtures requires ADR 0095 supersession; bounded live Pandoc contract plus small representative probes plus full replay in external-integration workflow preserves all assertion classes while enabling 184+ second Verify savings.
